{"id":"com.footy1x.footytools","version":"1.1.11","url":"https://footy1x.store/footytools/FootyTools-1.1.11.zxp","sha256":"4ed2a3753654b5fb4841a43fcfae7671c26ccee079ed546588c2c2c7c48cc2a6","size":389837,"notes":"1.1.11 (26 Oct 2026)
- Welcome screen: pick your language, a theme (Match After Effects, dark or light, eight accent colours)
  and your name the first time you open the panel. Change them any time from the gear at the top.
- 7 languages: English, Español, Português, Français, Italiano, Deutsch and Türkçe. Every button, tip and
  message is translated.
- Search bar: type to find any tool, any After Effects effect or any of your presets, then press Enter to
  apply it. Click + to pin it to the Quick bar.
- Quick bar: your own buttons now. Pin anything from the search, right-click a button to remove it, and press
  1-9 to use them. Reset brings back the standard bar.
- BG remover (FX tab): cuts the player out of a clip on your computer and puts the cutout straight into After
  Effects over the original. Fast mode is ready; Best mode downloads a bigger model once.
- Presets: Add preset (copies .ffx files into your Footy Tools presets folder), Open folder, Save as preset,
  and apply a preset with its keyframes stretched to fit the layer.
- Time tab: counts your work time on its own (only while After Effects is open and you're working in it):
  this session, today, this month, this year, and a calendar shaded by how much you worked each day.
- Smart cuts: finds where the shots change inside a clip and splits it, marks the cuts, or adds one
  adjustment layer per shot.
- Balance brightness: evens out the exposure of the selected clips so they match.
- Caption styles: Clean, Shorts, Hard, Cinema and Box (a box that sizes itself to the words).
- Reframe this comp or every comp in the project to a new size, layers kept centred. Fit solids and adjustment
  layers to the comp. Staircase layers. Room or big reverb on sound layers.","published":"2026-10-26"}
